scope: Static audit of application activation and double-click handling in the panel's Applications menu.

findings: The integrated menu uses onClicked for app rows, pins, and favorites; leaf activation calls Kicker model.trigger through dispatchNative().
The panel code contains no onDoubleClicked handler for these application entries.
dispatchNative records that native dispatch returned; it does not observe whether the launched application accepted or completed its request.
The stock KDE menu triggers a leaf application from MouseArea.onReleased once for each completed press/release and closes the menu.
Keyboard activation triggers the model once for Return/Enter and closes the menu.
No onDoubleClicked handler is present in this delegate.

interpretation: The reviewed paths do not implement a special double-click launch action. A double click can still produce ordinary repeated click sequences, and this static audit cannot explain the reported application stall or Plasma restart.
